items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 17:1
items.html: (To the question) The seventh aspect, which is Keter, is not a degree in itself, for it comes together with the Mochin. And what he counts the seventh degree as a degree in itself is because it does not operate in this time. But in YESHSUT it operates also in this time, namely on Rosh Chodesh and on Yom Tov, as is known; therefore he does not count it separately.
